compatibility.purpose: Synthesis of dimension-preserving architecture, Boolean scope and backward-compatibility obligations. No training, stable-source edit, paper edit or frozen-artifact edit.

actual_parameterizations.name: paper/general and stable literal OMBU
actual_parameterizations.notes: Stable OMBU uses tensor broadcast and reduction; learned or fixed signs are distinct function classes.

actual_parameterizations.name: consumer default odd K
actual_parameterizations.notes: Real-valued initial identity. Not universal IEEE bit identity under arbitrary K/reduction; tested odd K=17 counterexample.

actual_parameterizations.name: consumer default even K
actual_parameterizations.notes: Real initial identity, but all-positive coefficients mean monotone sigmoid/ReLU response. Symmetric independent biases and symmetric updates stay tied; existing capacity report reproduces trap.

actual_parameterizations.name: frontier residual study
actual_parameterizations.notes: Retains ordinary path; real identity at a=0. Additional width derivative may be useful while shared input derivative at zero is unchanged.

dimension_and_cost.incoming_dense: Baseline W(C,d)+b(C): Cd+C. Profile using same W with absorbed affine bias: Cd+KC (fixed coefficients), Cd+2KC (learned coefficients). Extra relative to baseline: (K-1)C or (2K-1)C. Separate gain/offsets/indexing must be counted additionally.
dimension_and_cost.incoming_conv: W(C,Cin,h,w) unchanged; profile biases/coefficients scale O(KC), and following convolution stays width C.
dimension_and_cost.li2016_concat_comparison: With C branch-source channels and D next-layer channels, K concatenated outputs require next weights KDChw rather than DChw, plus KC biases. Summed profiles retain DChw next weights; branch response tensor may still be KC internally.
dimension_and_cost.operations: One projection per channel; K base nonlinear evaluations and O(K) scalar sum work per output. Output shape unchanged does not imply unchanged FLOPs, latency, activation workspace or backward storage.
dimension_and_cost.memory: Naive vectorized forward materializes (...,C,K) or (B,C,K,H,W); transient memory O(K*B*C*H*W). Sequential/fused evaluation and custom backward/recomputation can reduce workspace, with separately measured latency and training cost.

supported_theorems.name: real identity nesting
supported_theorems.statement: If all b_k=b and sum(s_k)=1, sum s_k phi(z+b)=phi(z+b) over exact real arithmetic. Enlarged class contains baseline only when coefficient/bias/gap constraints allow this setting.

supported_theorems.name: risk inclusion
supported_theorems.statement: For exactly nested classes and same data objective/regularizer/constraints, infimum empirical or population risk cannot increase. Finite optimizer outcome, generalization, numerical trajectory and resource use need not improve.

supported_theorems.name: new parameter direction not new derivative of same input function
supported_theorems.statement: At a=0, paired residual is zero for every z and shared input derivative is unchanged. Width derivative is q*phi_prime(z+s), possibly nonzero when base path saturated; total loss gradient still vanishes under zero upstream gradient or aggregation cancellation.

supported_theorems.name: Boolean completeness on finite cube
supported_theorems.statement: A learned linear encoding w_i=2^(i-1) separates all 2^n binary vertices. Threshold transitions along this encoding realize any target with at most 2^n-1 ordered alternating hard thresholds when projection orientation/startup convention is chosen. Finite sigmoids yield exact hard labels for sufficient score margin/temperature, not exact soft values 0 or1.

supported_theorems.name: Boolean worst-case cannot stay small
supported_theorems.statement: For ordered multi-threshold classes, number of realizable projection orders is at most 2 sum_{j=0}^{n-1} C((3^n-3)/2,j). One order supports at most 2 sum_{j=0}^K C(2^n-1,j) label strings. Counting gives worst-case K>=2^(n-1)-O(n*2^(n/2)), hence Theta(2^n); structured functions including parity can be linear in n. See two-bias report lines332-370; do not generalize this bound to unrelated unconstrained infinite-precision architectures.

supported_theorems.name: ridge obstruction
supported_theorems.statement: A scalar profile p(w^T x) is constant on each w-orthogonal hyperplane. Arbitrary Boolean lookup representation on a finite set does not give arbitrary continuous multidimensional geometry. Multiple learned directions remain necessary for generic tasks.

boolean_conventions_and_truth_status.sigmoid_XOR: w=(10,10), b=(-5,-15), s=(+1,-1), hard threshold0.5 gives 0,1,1,0 in both float32 andfloat64. Four learnable scalars, no learned branch coefficients required.
boolean_conventions_and_truth_status.ReLU_K2: ReLU(z+b1)-ReLU(z+b2) is monotone (possibly nonincreasing depending bias order), so a hard threshold cannot give a bounded positive XOR slab. Unequal real branch coefficients can give a hat. Paper K2 ReLU XOR uses signs(+1,-2).
boolean_conventions_and_truth_status.ordered_ReLU: If ordered thresholds and matching alternating signs start positive, derivative toggles0/1 so response is nondecreasing. This limitation is convention-specific.
boolean_conventions_and_truth_status.unordered_ReLU: Fixed coefficient multiset with freely permuted biases is not always monotone. Four branches +,-,+,- and thresholds(a,b,c,b) give ReLU(z-a)-2ReLU(z-b)+ReLU(z-c), a triangle when a+c=2b. Do not overclaim general fixed-sign ReLU monotonicity.
boolean_conventions_and_truth_status.even_alternating_sigmoid_embedding: Even K alternating fixed-sign sigmoid sum has zero limit at both +/-infinity; ordinary sigmoid has limits0 and1. It therefore cannot contain ordinary sigmoid globally without changing coefficients, adding baseline path or output rule. Default even-K positive averaging changes class to regain real identity.
boolean_conventions_and_truth_status.minimum_counts: Exact fully enumerated n<=4:1,2,3,5. Independently replayed n5 target has exactminimum7; certified current report7<=B0(5)<=31. The manuscript claim8 is not verified and its printed hard-witness lower-bound certificate is contradicted by a3-threshold construction. No exact formula for n5 worstcase established.
boolean_conventions_and_truth_status.robustness_tradeoff: For binary-place encoding w_i=2^(i-1), normalized L1 minimum score/threshold margin can shrink as O(2^-n). Completeness alone does not imply robust separation, learnability or useful compactness.

compatibility_recommendation.API: ProfileActivation(base=..., number_of_biases=1, parameterization="base_plus_residual", ...) preserving channel-first/channel-last interface; wrap existing affine bias consistently instead of duplicating it silently.
compatibility_recommendation.K1_contract: Dispatch directly to original base activation on the original preactivation, with no added +0, gain multiplication, tensor expansion/reduction or changed RNG call. Preserve training/eval state, dtype/device/layout, serialization and optimizer naming contracts. This can provide a genuine arithmetic-path-compatible K1 mode.
compatibility_recommendation.Kgreater_contract: Keep explicit ordinary path and add independently parameterized cancelling residual pairs/zero coefficients. Real identity at insertion; test implementation-specific finite FP tolerances separately. To promise strict bit identity across all finite/signed-zero/nonfinite values, require an inactive baseline bypass or a carefully checked custom forward/backward preserving valid shape derivatives. Naively skipping zero residual branches removes the new parameter gradient, so bypass design needs explicit tests.
compatibility_recommendation.default_adoption_gate: Dimension preservation and nested representation justify an optional extension; default superiority needs equally tuned/converged controls, same-resource costs, noninferior hard tasks, deterministic exports and broad dataset evidence. Offer K1 default or adaptive opt-in until evidence supports larger default K.
compatibility_recommendation.regularization: Regularize output profile variation/derivative and gain as needed, not only bias gaps. Minimum gaps alone can remove exact baseline nesting and do not ensure derivative coverage or class margin. Penalized objective may change inclusion comparison.

counterexamples: Real sum-to-one coefficients do not imply bit identity under FP multiplication/reduction.
Flattening cancelling residual into one sum changes reduction order and may change finite outputs.
Adding zero can change -0.0 sign even at K1.
Inf-Inf cancellation yields NaN despite base ReLU(+Inf)=+Inf.
Independent stochastic activation/dropout branch masks break samplewise identity even if algebraic coefficients sum1.
Different extra bias gradients alter optimization geometry; equal real forward function does not imply all parameter trajectories unchanged.
Zero upstream loss gradient remainszero after decomposition.
Exact class nesting fails under even fixed alternating sigmoid tails or strict mandatory gap constraints.

prior.scope: Read-only architectural and primary-source audit; no paper, library, or frozen-artifact edits.

user_distinction.verdict: Correct at the module interface; the 2016 concatenating MBA is not the same architecture as a per-channel summed scalar profile.

own_algebra.ordinary: z_n=(W*x)_n; y_n=phi(z_n+b_n), N input/output channels at activation.
own_algebra.li2016: h_m=sum_n sum_k V_mnk * phi(z_n+b_nk); activation interface N -> NK.
own_algebra.summed: p_n(z_n)=sum_k s_nk phi(z_n+b_nk); h_m=sum_n V_mn*p_n(z_n); activation interface N -> N.
own_algebra.factorization: Summed construction is embedded in an expanded layer by tying V_mnk[r]=V_mn[r]*s_nk for every destination m and spatial kernel offset r. This imposes separable rank-one factors over k versus (m,r) for each n. A vector-valued profile sum_k C_:nk phi(z_n+b_nk) permits destination-dependent mixing and is closer to an expanded MBA followed immediately by its linear readout.
own_algebra.costs: For a following dense convolution with N input channels, M output channels and q*q kernel, ordinary weights=NMq^2; expanded MBA weights=KNMq^2; summed profile retains NMq^2 and adds KN biases plus KN coefficients if learned. Relative added biases depend on whether ordinary per-channel b is kept/replaced. Fixed signs need not be stored as learned floating parameters. Intermediate training activation arrays may still scale with K unless fused/recomputed; unchanged public tensor shape does not mean unchanged FLOPs or peak workspace.
own_algebra.geometry: One unit is p(w^T x). Any thresholded scalar decision is a preimage of intervals: unions of parallel slabs/half-spaces, not arbitrary continuous multidirectional geometry. A layer with multiple w directions can combine richer geometry.
own_algebra.completeness: Finite Boolean-cube completeness can coexist with one projection because an injective weighted sum separates cube vertices; it says nothing by itself about practical bias count, numerical margins, learnability, or general continuous-input universality. Paper's ReLU proof uses unrestricted real coefficients and a hard output threshold; fixed alternating ReLU K=2 is monotone clipped ramp and cannot produce XOR. Smooth sigmoid difference K=2 is nonmonotone and can classify XOR.

sources.title: Li, Ouyang and Wang, Multi-Bias Non-linear Activation in Deep Neural Networks (ICML 2016)
locations: Printed p226/PDF p6, paragraph following Table1
sources.source_summary: Fig3 and Eq1 concatenate N maps into NK; Eq4 uses separate downstream kernels. Eqs7-8 rewrite the composite as shifted sums with destination/location-dependent coefficients. Sec2.3 explicitly contrasts this with within-channel APL summation. The cost paragraph counts downstream growth Nq²M(K−1) plus NK biases.
sources.limitation: This proves architectural overlap and an exact shape distinction, not identity of the proposed module or absence of every narrower contribution. Paper evaluates width variants; do not imply it ignores cost.

sources.title: Agostinelli et al., Learning Activation Functions to Improve Deep Neural Networks (ICLR workshop 2015)
sources.source_summary: APL uses max(0,z)+sum_s a_s max(0,−z+b_s), preserving scalar output with 2S learned scalars per unit. It fits nonconvex piecewise-linear shapes. Theorem1 characterizes representable tails; an outer affine map restores two degrees of freedom. Coefficient regularization addresses numerical instability.
sources.own_inference: Setting every a_s=0 recovers ReLU mathematically. Thus broad claims that APL cannot identity-embed ReLU, or needs K independent high-dimensional input projections, are false. Bitwise identity requires a specified finite-arithmetic implementation; neither algebra alone establishes arbitrary reduction-order identity.
sources.limitation: APL uses reflected ReLU hinges and constrained tails, not arbitrary base activation translates; paper does not establish the proposed Boolean counting theorem or adaptive pair-selection protocol.

sources.title: Chen, Goodfellow and Shlens, Net2Net (ICLR 2016)
sources.source_summary: Function-preserving transformations transfer a trained network into wider or deeper specifications.
sources.limitation: General function-preserving expansion precedent; not specifically a scalar activation-complexity allocator.

sources.title: Evci et al., GradMax (ICLR 2022)
sources.source_summary: Adds neurons without changing learned outputs and selects new-weight initialization by gradient maximization using SVD.
sources.limitation: Growth/gradient-selection precedent; activation-pair insertion with unchanged layer interfaces is narrower.

report_recommendations: Acknowledge the user's concrete N→N versus N→NK advantage early and use exact shape/cost formulas.

Describe summed profiles as a tied/factorized restriction of expanded responses; structural restriction can be useful regularization and deployment engineering, but not automatically better expressivity at equal K.
Do not claim dimensionality-preserving learnable shifted sums or ReLU baseline nesting are themselves new; compare APL and tied-weight variants.
Treat mathematical function nesting, finite precision bit identity, retained optimizer state, risk-class containment and actual finite-training/generalization gains as distinct contracts.
Preserve broad Boolean result with assumptions; avoid 'full logic for complex geometry' implying arbitrary geometry with a single ridge unit or uniformly small K.
